rules.description: Students may log in to the portal using credentials created in the previous academic session when applying for a scholarship.
rules.condition: The student has login credentials that were created in the previous academic session.
rules.outcome: The student is allowed to access the portal to submit a scholarship application.
rules.evidence_quote: The students will be able to login to portal using his/her login credentials created in previous academic session while applying for Scholarship.

rules.description: After a successful login, the system automatically fills personal and academic details of the student and the scheme on the application screen.
rules.condition: The student has successfully logged in to the portal.
rules.outcome: Personal and academic details are auto-populated on the screen.
rules.evidence_quote: Upon successful login, personal and academic details of student and scheme will be auto- populated on the screen.

rules.description: The student may update certain details in the scholarship application form after login.
rules.condition: The student is on the application form screen after login.
rules.outcome: The student is permitted to modify the listed details.
